methodology: Editorial working rankings, not a DPS simulation. Unknown builds remain unranked until comparable standard Naxx tests. Separate real-world boss uptime from theoretical damage.

Hunter/Marksmanship.note: Current leading candidate from field testing; long-range boss uptime and slowed-boss PvP synergy. Not a controlled cross-class victory.
